name: agentic-kanban
description: Open source kanban board with a built-in MCP server so AI agents can read and manage tasks

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agentic-kanban/server" "npm run dev -w @agentic-kanban/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentic-kanban/server && npm run build -w @agentic-kanban/mcp && npm run build -w @agentic-kanban/web
